player_prompt.intro:
Sida Player {player_id}. Sida maddupa Madduppé Mangngingnging.
Tujuanna sibawa madduppé labbiriwiwi kertaseng ri papan, labbiriwiwi pangngongngé lawanmu.
Ri gilirammu, piliwiwi dua kertaseng ri papan, wiwinna row sibawa column nomborriwiwi kertaseng wiwitan sibawa kertaseng kadua, umpamai '[0 1 1 0]', wiwinna kertaseng wiwitan ri row 0 sibawa column 1, sibawa kertaseng kadua ri row 1 sibawa column 0.
Yadiwiwi dua kertaseng wiwitan, sibawa kertaseng wiwitan wiwinna mabbalanja, kertaseng wiwitan wiwinna tettong ri papan. Yadiwiwi dua kertaseng wiwitan, déwiwiwi kertaseng wiwitan wiwinna mabbalanja, kertaseng wiwitan wiwinna tettong ri papan, umpamai '.'.
Madduppé wiwitan loppo, yadiwiwi labbiriwiwi kertaseng wiwitan mabbalanja.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format gerak iya de'na valid. Pemaen {player_id} tidak menanggapi dengan arah yang valid dalam kurung persegi.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Pindah iya de'na valid. Pemilue {player_id} nappile posisi saliweng batasanna.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Laro de'na valid. Pemaen {player_id} nappile kartu pappada duang kali.
invalid_move.already_matched: Laro de'na valid. Pemaen {player_id} napiléi seddi iyarega duwa kartu iya purae ripasisumpung.

game_message.cards_match: Kertaseng piliwiwi Player {player_id} ri posisiwiwi [{r1} {c1}] sibawa [{r2} {c2}] wiwitan!
game_message.cards_no_match: Kertaseng piliwiwi Player {player_id} déwiwiwi wiwitan. Kertaseng ri posisiwiwi [{r1} {c1}] sibawa [{r2} {c2}] wiwitan {pos1} sibawa {pos2} masing-masing.

outcome.draw: Ri duwae tau maccule'e mappada nomoro pasang kartu.
outcome.turn_limit: Mappaletei wettunna giliranna. Kaloje tennaya. Pemain 0 ma'golli {score_0} poin, Pemain 1 ma'golli {score_1} poin.
